# SHRINEVA

> Commercial and mixed-use building for lease at D-15, Bada Lalpur, Chandmari, near Apollo Hospital & NIFT, Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh 221003. VDA-approved Parking + 3 building: open parking level plus three whole floors on a 525 sq m plot with about 50 ft of frontage on a 24 m road. Leasing enquiries: +91 73557 70378 or +91 81140 80609 (WhatsApp), leasing@shrineva.com.

Status (owner, 15 October 2026): Under construction; structure almost complete; handover March 2027. Floor-wise modifications can be considered as per your requirement.

Key features (owner-specified, not certificates): Vastu compliant; Column-free structure; Fire safety; 24×7 safety; Fine dining; Offices; 4-side open plot. Services: Parking, Internet, DG power backup.

Notes: areas are computed from the architect's sheets and are not certified; parking capacity is not fixed; 3D images and the 3D walkthrough are indicative and subject to change; nothing here is an offer. Opening years for the Apollo hospital (OPD 2027) and the NIFT campus (2027) are the owner's expectations.

## Approximate distances
- NIFT Varanasi: 60–70 m (Across the road)
- Apollo Hospitals: 60–70 m (Under construction)
- Varanasi Trade Centre: ≈ 330 m (Along the road)
- Vardhan Hospital, Lalpur: Nearby (Bada Lalpur, near the Trade Centre)
- Ring Road (NH 135B): ≈ 1 km (By road)
- Ganjari Cricket Stadium: ≈ 20 km (By road, approx.)

## Nearby projects (reviewed 15 October 2026)
- Apollo Medics hospital (About 60–70 m): Under construction. OPD expected to start in 2027 (the owner's expectation; no opening date found in published reports). VDA building plan approved, reported September 2025.
- NIFT Varanasi (About 60–70 m): Classes since July 2024 in temporary space. Main campus under construction since January 2025; expected ready in 2027 (the owner's expectation; NIFT has not published a completion date).
- Deendayal Hastkala Sankul (Varanasi Trade Centre) (About 330 m): Operating. First phase opened December 2016, fully dedicated September 2017.
